detailed_description: Input product shoe images and background reference photos. The workflow generates 3 videos: two premium studio macro spec film that orbits and details the shoe upper, midsole and outsole in a dark technical environment, and an outdoor cinematic trail scene placing the shoe on a real runner across the referenced terrain with dust, impact and natural light.
